svg.text: ESP32-S3 (Lonely Binary, screw-terminal breakout) · TMC5160T Pro · AS5600 I2C · WS2815 halo · PCM5102A -> TPA3116D2
CFG0-3 + CLK pins bent out, jumpered
inject 12 V both ends · 330 ohm on DI
LED GND -> 12 V PSU V- (heavy 14 AWG)
EN is ACTIVE LOW: drive LOW to run
2200 uF / 35 V across VM-GND at driver
bridged output: neither terminal to GND
USB -> S3 native USB port (program/tune only)
Dashed = shared rail continuation. Fuses: 24 V motor 5 A, 24 V amp 3 A, 12 V LEDs 5 A. All grounds meet once at STAR GND.
Driver SPI mode 3. AS5600 on its own I2C bus (GPIO38/39, 400 kHz). PCM5102A: SCK to GND and XSMT to 3V3 are required jumpers.
If STEP/DIR/EN terminals 5/6/7 are absent on the breakout, substitute 47/48/21 and keep the rest unchanged.
